# Contracted and Special Personnel
The Company employs armed contractors through PMC Dispatch (division 4). Contractors aren't Company office staff and don't hold office grades. They take their orders from their own leadership, and their leadership takes its orders from whoever is paying for the contract.
Site staff don't request contractors directly. Requests go through the senior employee on site to PMC Dispatch, with a justification, in writing.
## PMC operators - [bold]PMC-OP Operator[/bold] (PMC. OPR.): line operator. - [bold]PMC-EN Enforcer[/bold] (PMC. ENF.): breaching and suppression. - [bold]PMC-VS Vehicle Specialist[/bold] (PMC. SPV.): vehicle crew. - [bold]PMC-SS Support Specialist[/bold] (PMC. SPS.): sustained fire. - [bold]PMC-MS Medical Specialist[/bold] (PMC. SPM.): keeps the expensive assets breathing. - [bold]PMC-WS Weapon Specialist[/bold] (PMC. SPW.): precision and heavy weapons. - [bold]PMC-CCS Crowd Control Specialist[/bold] (PMC. SPCC.): riot control and keeping crowds away from Company property. - [bold]PMC-TEC Corporate Technician[/bold] (PMC. TEC.): field engineering. - [bold]PMC-DOC Trauma Surgeon[/bold] (PMC. Dr.): contracted surgical support.
## PMC leadership - [bold]PMC-TL Team Leader[/bold] (PMC. TML.): commands the fireteam. - [bold]PMC-FOL Field Operations Leader[/bold] (PMC. FOL.): commands several teams in the field. - [bold]PMC-DIR Site Director[/bold] (PMC. DIR.): the contractor's senior officer at a site. Not to be confused with a Company Director.
## Withdrawal team Sent down on the Company's own shuttle when the Company divests from a colony. - [bold]WYPO2 Commercial Pilot[/bold] (WYCP): flies the shuttle and commands the team until it is back in orbit. - [bold]WY-SEC Security Officer[/bold]: secures the landing zone and escorts Company staff aboard.
## Corporate Commandos Commandos answer directly to Company High Command. Their deployments don't appear in site records. Site staff are not told they are coming and shouldn't ask afterwards. - [bold]WY-COM Corporate Commando[/bold] (WYCDO. OPR.) - [bold]WY-GUN Corporate Commando Gunner[/bold] (WYCDO. GNR.) - [bold]WY-DOG Corporate Commando Dog Catcher[/bold] (WYCDO. DC.): live specimen recovery. Where the rest of a team is sent to leave nothing behind, the Dog Catcher is sent to bring something back. Capture procedure: put the specimen down with repeated Somnazine tranquilizer slugs, drag it onto an open secure specimen crate, and close the lid. Further slugs keep a sedated specimen under for longer. A crated specimen stays sedated and sealed until Corporate Security opens the crate. - [bold]WY-COMLD Corporate Commando Leader[/bold] (WYCDO. TML.)
## Whiteout Whiteout units are combat synthetic Corporate Commandos. They take orders only from the Company personnel they were deployed for, and only a Director can override them. If one arrives, the situation is no longer the site's to manage. - A [bold]Whiteout team[/bold] (a Leader, two Gunners, a Commando and a Dog Catcher) is sent when the Company wants a specimen recovered and the site cleaned up behind it. - A [bold]Whiteout kill squad[/bold] (a Leader, two Gunners and two Commandos) is sent when the Company wants nothing left at all. - Site staff are not told either is coming. Executives who learn of a deployment don't share it.
